prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly polished professional desktop SaaS application concept for Wisesama security response. COMPOSITION B, "Projects first": a landscape-ish presentation board containing TWO FULL DESKTOP APP SCREENSHOTS stacked vertically, DARK MODE above and exact corresponding LIGHT MODE below, each 1440x800 proportions; about 1600x1900 total. Outside screenshots only "B — Projects first" and small Dark/Light labels. No physical laptop mockups.
Use attached existing Wisesama screenshot ONLY for the existing geometric purple logo/wordmark, Satoshi/Clash Display typography feel and dark pink/purple brand. New product, NOT crypto copy; no copied marketing hero or gradients.
Instead of a sidebar, use compact top horizontal product navigation: existing mark/wordmark left, "Workspace" "Briefings" "Projects" "Notifications", right search icon, theme switch, avatar. A second thin breadcrumb line "Acme / Engineering". Main generous heading "Your software, in focus." 32px and subtitle "Track the services you run and the security issues that matter to them." purple "Add project" aligned right, quiet "Import inventory" nearby. Small clear "Demo workspace".
The main focus is a WIDE PROJECT INVENTORY TABLE, not a card grid. Columns "Project", "Environment", "Inventory", "Needs action", "Last checked". Three richly typeset rows: production-api / Production / "Node.js 22.23.3 · 126 packages" / red "1 critical · 1 high" / "8 min ago"; marketing-web / Production / "Next.js · 94 packages" / neutral "Needs version check" / "12 min ago"; legacy-checkout / Staging / "PHP 8.3.35 · 38 packages" / amber "1 high" / "21 min ago". Selected production-api row with purple-tinted background.
Below table, expanded selected project workspace taking remaining width: left 65% heading "production-api" and tabs "Findings 2" "Inventory" "Activity". A crisp table of findings "Brotli decoder memory corruption" CVE-2026-111497, High, affected installed 22.23.3 → fixed 22.23.4, status Open; "Inventory needs deployment confirmation" no CVE label, status Needs assessment. Right 35% is a quiet project context panel, clean unboxed sections "Runtime" Node.js 22.23.3; "Environment" Production; "Evidence collected" Today 09:42; "Coverage" "Package inventory imported. Running deployment not yet verified." Main button "Review finding". Bottom tiny "Demonstration data — import your inventory to get started."
Dark uses near-black #0c0c11, charcoal #15141d, warm white, lavender secondary, #7c3aed primary and #e6007a sparse accent. Light uses pale lavender gray #f8f7fa, white table, charcoal text, purple navigation marker and purple primary action. Both modes have exact same hierarchy and refined spacing, slim line icons, subtle 1px separators, no excessive boxes or giant metrics. Understated operational sophistication. No gradients/glow, no charts without purpose, no invented marketing claims, no decorative imagery. Sharp readable UI copy, complete screenshot content, no clipped navigation or controls.
